test_debug_features: Read Exception Status (FC 0x07, serial only) — returns 8 device-specific exception-status bits in a single byte; lowest-bit-numbered output is the LSB of the returned byte.

Diagnostics (FC 0x08, serial only) — 14 standard sub-functions covering loopback (sub 0 Return Query Data), restart of comm option (sub 1), diagnostic-register read (sub 2), ASCII-input-delimiter change (sub 3), Force Listen Only Mode (sub 4), Clear Counters (sub 10), and counter readouts (sub 11..18, 20).
Get Comm Event Counter (FC 0x0B, serial only) — returns Status (2 B) + Event Count (2 B); Event Count increments on every successfully processed request.

Get Comm Event Log (FC 0x0C, serial only) — returns Byte Count + Status + Event Count + Message Count + up to 64 event-record bytes; allows post-mortem reconstruction of the last several transactions.
Report Server ID (FC 0x11, serial only) — returns Byte Count + device-specific Server ID + Run Indicator Status (0xFF = ON, 0x00 = OFF) + additional device-specific data.
Exception responses (Function | 0x80 + Exception Code) — built-in mechanism for the server to tell the client exactly which validation gate failed.

spec_provided_observability.name: Function Code MSB of response
spec_provided_observability.purpose: If set, response is an exception; reveals validation gate that failed via the Exception Code byte.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x01 ILLEGAL FUNCTION
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Function code not implemented.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x02 ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Address + quantity outside server's data space.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x03 ILLEGAL DATA VALUE
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Structural value (quantity / byte count / etc.) outside the per-function limit.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x04 SERVER DEVICE FAILURE
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Internal unrecoverable error during execution.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Long-running programming command accepted; prevents client timeout.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x06 SERVER DEVICE BUSY
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Server busy with another long command; retransmit later.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x08 MEMORY PARITY ERROR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: FC 20/21 reference type 6 area consistency check failed.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x0A GATEWAY PATH UNAVAILABLE
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Gateway misconfigured or overloaded.

spec_provided_observability.name: Exception Code 0x0B GATEWAY TARGET FAILED TO RESPOND
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Gateway forwarded the request; target sub-device didn't reply.

spec_provided_observability.name: Diagnostic Register (FC 0x08 sub 0x02)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Server-internal diagnostic word — implementation-defined contents.

spec_provided_observability.name: Bus Message Count (FC 0x08 sub 11)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: All messages detected on the bus since last clear / power-up.

spec_provided_observability.name: Bus Communication Error Count (FC 0x08 sub 12)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Frames with CRC/LRC/parity/framing errors.

spec_provided_observability.name: Bus Exception Error Count (FC 0x08 sub 13)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Exception responses sent by this server.

spec_provided_observability.name: Server Message Count (FC 0x08 sub 14)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Messages addressed to this server (incl. broadcasts).

spec_provided_observability.name: Server No Response Count (FC 0x08 sub 15)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Server received message but no response sent (incl. broadcast).

spec_provided_observability.name: Server NAK Count (FC 0x08 sub 16)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Negative-acknowledge exception responses sent.

spec_provided_observability.name: Server Busy Count (FC 0x08 sub 17)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Server Device Busy exceptions sent.

spec_provided_observability.name: Bus Character Overrun Count (FC 0x08 sub 18)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Characters received with no buffer space (overrun).

spec_provided_observability.name: Comm Event Counter (FC 0x0B)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Successful-message event counter.

spec_provided_observability.name: Comm Event Log (FC 0x0C, ≤ 64 events)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Recent transaction-event history for post-mortem.

spec_provided_observability.name: Run Indicator Status (FC 0x11)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 0xFF = server running; 0x00 = server stopped.

interrupt_sources.flag: New ADU received on serial RX
interrupt_sources.trigger: End-of-frame detected (T3.5 silence on RTU, CR LF on ASCII).
Implementation-dependent — when underlying UART / TCP socket can accept next byte/segment.
RTU end-of-frame trigger; drives receive-frame-complete pulse.

interrupt_request: Not specified by MODBUS itself. Implementation-defined: serial implementations typically use the UART's RX interrupt + a one-shot timer for T3.5 detection; TCP implementations rely on socket-recv callbacks.
notes: MODBUS provides rich built-in diagnostic visibility through Function Codes 7, 8, 11, 12, and 17 — collectively the spec calls them the Diagnostic / Communications Event Log / Server ID subsystem. These run only over serial-line transports (RTU / ASCII); equivalent diagnostics over Modbus TCP are vendor-specific and typically replaced by SNMP / proprietary management protocols.
